name: myhsk
description: A mobile-first Chinese learning app for connected HSK vocabulary and clue-based character reading.

scripts.build: npm run content:build && tsc -b && vite build && node scripts/prune-production.mjs
scripts.content:build: node scripts/build-content.mjs && node scripts/build-networks.mjs && node scripts/build-word-insights.mjs && node scripts/build-character-curriculum.mjs && node scripts/build-priority-features.mjs && node scripts/build-sentence-shards.mjs && node scripts/build-open-dictionary-shards.mjs
scripts.check: npm run content:build && npm run content:validate && tsc -b
